nodes.label: KeycloakMain
nodes.desc: Quarkus entry point: main() parses CLI options and hands control to Quarkus.run to boot the server.

nodes.label: Providers scan
nodes.desc: getProviderManager(classLoader) scans the classpath at build time and registers every SPI ProviderFactory it finds.

nodes.label: QuarkusKeycloakSessionFactory
nodes.desc: Extends DefaultKeycloakSessionFactory; wires pre-built provider maps and creates a KeycloakSession per request.

nodes.label: AuthorizationEndpoint
nodes.desc: @GET /protocol/openid-connect/auth: validates OAuth2 params and starts the realm's browser flow.

nodes.label: LoginActionsService
nodes.desc: Serves /authenticate, /registration and /reset-credentials; re-enters the flow when the user posts a form.

nodes.label: AuthenticationProcessor
nodes.desc: Carries auth session state between requests; authenticate() and authenticateOnly() drive the configured flow.

nodes.label: DefaultAuthenticationFlow
nodes.desc: processFlow() splits executions into required and alternative lists and walks them according to realm config.

nodes.label: CookieAuthenticator
nodes.desc: authenticate() checks the SSO identity cookie to resume an existing session without a login form.

nodes.label: UsernamePasswordForm
nodes.desc: action() validates the posted credentials via validateUserAndPassword and sets the authenticated user.

nodes.label: TokenEndpoint
nodes.desc: @POST /protocol/openid-connect/token: dispatches on grant_type to the matching OAuth2GrantType provider.

nodes.label: TokenManager
nodes.desc: AccessTokenResponseBuilder assembles access, refresh and ID tokens and signs them via SignatureProvider.

nodes.label: LDAPStorageProvider
nodes.desc: UserStorageProvider that binds the login flow to an external LDAP/AD directory.
